tool.name: gff3ToGenePred
tool.description: convert a GFF3 gene annotation to genePred
tool.command:
ln -sf '$input' 'input.gff3' && gff3ToGenePred $use_name $warn_and_continue $process_all_gene_children $allow_minimal_genes 'input.gff3' '$output'
## ⛔ PROVE THE OUTPUT ARRIVED WHOLE. Galaxy has no job-time output validation, so a ## truncated write is a GREEN job: the file is still tabular, still sniffs as its datatype, ## and only breaks whatever reads it next. An empty result and a ragged final line are the ## two shapes a short write takes here, and both are decidable from the file alone. ## ⚠ Not a row-count comparison against the input: this conversion is not 1:1 and a ## legitimate drop would then look like a truncation. && awk -F'\t' 'NF != 15 { printf("%s: line %d has %d columns, want %d\n", "gff3ToGenePred", NR, NF, 15) > "/dev/stderr"; bad = 1 } END { if (NR == 0) { printf("%s: no rows written\n", "gff3ToGenePred") > "/dev/stderr"; bad = 1 } exit bad }' '$output'

param.name: use_name
param.label: Use Name attribute as name
param.help: Use the 'Name' tag as the genePred name, if present.

param.name: warn_and_continue
param.label: Warn and continue
param.help: On bad genePreds being created, emit a warning but continue.

param.name: process_all_gene_children
param.label: Process all gene children
param.help: Output a genePred for all children of a gene regardless of feature type.

param.name: allow_minimal_genes
param.label: Allow minimal genes
param.help: Convert genes whose exons are direct children, and stand-alone genes with no transcript/exon children.

tool.help:
**gff3ToGenePred** — convert a GFF3 gene annotation into the UCSC **genePred** table format.
genePred is the tab-delimited gene-model representation used throughout the UCSC tooling. It is the intermediate step when turning a GFF3 annotation into a browsable BED12 / bigGenePred track: `gff3ToGenePred` then `genePredToBed`.
-----
**Input**
- `Input GFF3` — a GFF3 file with gene / RNA / exon / CDS records.
**Output**
- A 15-column genePred table (name, chrom, strand, txStart, txEnd, cdsStart, cdsEnd, exonCount, exonStarts, exonEnds, score, name2, cdsStartStat, cdsEndStat, exonFrames).
-----
**Key options**
- `-useName` — use the GFF3 `Name` attribute as the genePred name. - `-warnAndContinue` — keep going past records that fail genePred checks. - `-processAllGeneChildren` / `-allowMinimalGenes` — relax the expected gene→transcript→exon hierarchy for atypical GFF3.
-----
**References**
- UCSC GFF3 format: https://genome.ucsc.edu/FAQ/FAQformat.html#format3 - `gff3ToGenePred` source: https://github.com/ucscGenomeBrowser/kent/blob/master/src/hg/utils/gff3ToGenePred/gff3ToGenePred.c - Pre-built binaries and the full usage text: https://hgdownload.soe.ucsc.edu/admin/exe/linux.x86_64/FOOTER.txt
This wrapper exposes the options that matter to a Galaxy job. gff3ToGenePred also accepts `-attrsOut`, `-bad`, `-defaultCdsStatusToUnknown`, `-geneNameAttr`, `-honorStartStopCodons`, `-maxConvertErrors`, `-maxParseErrors`, `-refseqHacks`, `-rnaNameAttr`, `-unprocessedRootsOut`, which are either process tuning or write paths a job cannot use; run `gff3ToGenePred` with no arguments to see the program's own list.
